bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
sql="SELECT count(DISTINCT board_key) FROM posting_topics WHERE purpose='profile' AND enabled=TRUE AND verified_at IS NOT NULL AND verified_by IS NOT NULL AND title='みんなのプロフ' AND ((board_key='area_bbs' AND chat_id=-1003847210571) OR (board_key='video_chat' AND chat_id=-1002373696859) OR (board_key='gay_board' AND chat_id=-1003770334893))"
count="$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "$sql")"
if test "$count" != 3; then echo PROFILE_BOARD_VERIFIED_ROUTE_COUNT_NOT_THREE; exit 41; fi
sql="SELECT count(*) FROM gaybbs_feature_release_gates WHERE feature='profile' AND enabled=TRUE AND length(source_commit)=40 AND length(trim(ci_evidence))>0 AND length(trim(gserver_runtime_evidence))>0 AND length(trim(telegram_e2e_evidence))>0 AND approved_by IS NOT NULL"
count="$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "$sql")"
if test "$count" != 1; then echo PROFILE_PUBLIC_RELEASE_GATE_NOT_READY; exit 42; fi
echo PROFILE_BOARD_ROUTE_AND_RELEASE=PASS
